{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rite of Fira''' was the ritual of initiation into the [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]]-based organization known as [[Order of Shasa]] of [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].

Students deemed ready to become full members of the Order were sent on a special quest that served as a final test of their abilities, reminding them of the reason the Order was founded and providing them with a weapon for personal defense. The Rite of Fira required the initiate to swim to the wreck of the [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] harvester destroyed by [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] in the [[Hrakert Rift]] in [[3956 BBY]]. After removing a piece of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis]] from its hull plating, the initiate then used the heat from volcanic vents on the ocean floor to craft the cortosis into a [[fira]] &mdash; a curved, [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]-resistant sword, which members of the Order used to defend themselves against possible threats.
